system_prompt: You are a structural biologist studying drug resistance. Always respond with valid JSON containing a 'modifications' list. Each modification must include 'description', 'smiles', and 'rationale' fields.

modifications.description: Add a guanidino group to replace the amine group on the cyclohexene ring
modifications.rationale: The guanidino group can improve binding affinity to drug-resistant neuraminidase variants by forming additional hydrogen bonds and electrostatic interactions with conserved residues in the active site.

modifications.description: Introduce a hydroxyl group on the 3-position of the cyclohexene ring
modifications.rationale: Adding a hydroxyl group can enhance interactions with the active site through hydrogen bonding, potentially compensating for resistance-associated mutations.

modifications.description: Replace the ethyl ester with a hydroxymethyl group
modifications.rationale: Replacing the ester group with a hydroxymethyl group may improve the stability and binding of the drug to neuraminidase, addressing structural changes from resistance mutations.
